title: 2 Bedroom Apartment in Chiado, Lisbon
description: Stunning 2-bedroom apartment in the heart of Chiado, Lisbon's most iconic neighbourhood. This fully renovated property features original wood floors, high ceilings, and views over the rooftops of Lisbon. Steps from Rua Garrett, Largo do Chiado, and the famous A Brasileira café. Perfect for buyers seeking a lifestyle property or investment in one of Europe's most desirable markets.

title: Studio Apartment in Ribeira, Porto
description: Charming studio apartment located in Porto's UNESCO-listed Ribeira district. Fully furnished and recently renovated with exposed stone walls and traditional azulejo tiles. Walking distance to the Douro River, Dom Luís I Bridge, and some of Porto's best restaurants. An excellent entry-level investment with strong short-term rental potential.

title: 4 Bedroom Villa with Pool in Albufeira, Algarve
description: Impressive 4-bedroom detached villa in a quiet residential area of Albufeira, just 10 minutes from the beach. Featuring a private swimming pool, landscaped garden, covered terrace, and garage. South-facing with panoramic views over the hills. The interior is spacious and bright with an open-plan living area, modern kitchen, and large master suite. Ideal as a permanent residence, holiday home, or rental investment.

title: Townhouse with River Views in Alfama, Lisbon
description: Beautifully restored 3-bedroom townhouse in Alfama, Lisbon's oldest neighbourhood. This traditional Portuguese home features terracotta tile floors, a private rooftop terrace with sweeping views over the Tagus River, and exposed wooden beams throughout. Located within walking distance of the Sé Cathedral and São Jorge Castle. A rare opportunity to own a character property in one of Lisbon's most sought-after areas.

title: Restored Stone Cottage near Óbidos, Silver Coast
description: Enchanting 2-bedroom stone cottage lovingly restored 5km from the medieval walled town of Óbidos. Set on 1,500sqm of garden with fruit trees and a vegetable patch. Original stone walls, wooden beams, and a fireplace give this property tremendous character. The Silver Coast beaches at Lagoa de Óbidos are 15 minutes away. Perfect for buyers seeking a peaceful rural retreat within easy reach of Lisbon (1 hour).

title: Farmhouse with Vineyard near Évora, Alentejo
description: Magnificent Alentejo farmhouse (Monte) set on 8 hectares of rolling countryside near Arraiolos, 20 minutes from UNESCO-listed Évora. The property includes a productive vineyard, olive grove, and cork trees. The main house has been sensitively restored with 5 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a country kitchen, dining hall, and multiple living spaces. A large stone terrace overlooks the estate. Huge potential for agritourism or as a luxury private residence.
